definitions.explanation: A Japanese manual therapy that aims to correct the alignment of the spine, joints, and pelvis through hands-on manipulation. Practiced in private studios called {整体院|せいたいいん}; not a formally licensed profession in Japan, unlike massage or judo therapy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腰痛|ようつう}→腰痛：05020_youtsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{整体|せいたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I go to a seitai clinic because of lower back pain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{骨盤|こつばん}→骨盤：05963_kotsuban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歪|ゆが}み→歪み：09409_yugami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{整体|せいたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{矯正|きょうせい}→矯正：14784_kyousei⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the pelvic misalignment corrected with a seitai treatment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肩|かた}こり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{月一回|つきいっかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{整体|せいたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧だいぶ⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧になった。
examples.english: My years of shoulder stiffness have eased considerably thanks to monthly seitai sessions.

notes:
Compound of {整|せい} ("to arrange, align") + ⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ ("body"). Note that {整体|せいたい} is homophonous with ⟦{声帯|せいたい}→声帯：12156_seitai⟧ (vocal cords) and ⟦{生態|せいたい}→生態：13543_seitai⟧ (ecology) — context disambiguates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {整体|せいたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to go to a seitai clinic regularly
- {整体|せいたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to get a seitai treatment
- {整体|せいたい}{師|し}: seitai practitioner
- {整体|せいたい}{院|いん}: seitai clinic
- ⟦{骨盤|こつばん}→骨盤：05963_kotsuban⟧⟦{矯正|きょうせい}→矯正：14784_kyousei⟧{整体|せいたい}: pelvic-alignment seitai

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{指圧|しあつ}→指圧：27406_shiatsu⟧: shiatsu — finger-pressure massage; licensed profession
- カイロプラクティック: chiropractic — Western adjustment system; similar in approach
- ⟦{整骨|せいこつ}→整骨：24109_seikotsu⟧/{接骨|せっこつ}: osteopathy/bonesetting — focuses on bone and joint injuries; nationally licensed
